integrity: The fresh primary source was checked at its Hénon definitions, parabolicity criterion, simple and stronger biholomorphism criteria, normalization series, and concluding nonconvergent-quotient question. The older Fornæss–Pal critical-scale theorem was inspected in its primary preprint. The new phase boundary is established by explicit dyadic quotient, product, normalization-exponent, and tail calculations; no numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: For \(\gamma>1\), equivalently lower quotient limit \(L<1\), the basin is proved parabolic and the derivative-normalization series is proved divergent, but biholomorphism with \(\mathbb C^2\) is not determined. The family therefore does not produce a proved third biholomorphism type, and no universality claim is made beyond the dyadic model.
title: A sharp quotient-floor phase boundary for critical non-autonomous Hénon basins
